card.name: Linking words in boxed opioid warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words (AND, OF, WITH) in all-caps boxed warning headings, right before a drug name or risk term such as codeine, promethazine, or respiratory depressants.

modes.label: AND between drug names
modes.description: The word AND joining two drug names in an all-caps warning title.
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS AND LIFE-THREATENING RISKS FROM USE OF PENTAZOCINE<< AND>> NALOXONE TABLETS Addiction,

modes.label: OF or WITH before a drug or risk
modes.description: OF or WITH after a noun like metabolism, use or administration, leading into a named drug or drug class.
modes.example: FROM CONCOMITANT USE WITH BENZODIAZEPINES OR OTHER CNS DEPRESSANTS; ULTRA-RAPID METABOLISM<< OF>> CODEINE AND OTHER RISK FACTORS

card.writes: It lowers the chance of the word code, so the model is steered away from codeine-like continuations.
card.plain: It marks the small linking word in capitalized opioid and promethazine warning headings just before the next drug name.
